British comedian Russell Brand was found guilty of rape and sexual assault on
Thursday.

After a four-week trial examining alleged offenses committed between 2004 and
2009, a jury found him [guilty ](https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-
arts/story/2026-11-05/russell-brand-verdict-convicted-rape-sexual-assault)of
one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault, altogether involving
four women.

Brand, the provocative and internationally recognized comic and former spouse
of music star Katy Perry, has denied the allegations.

The conviction comes just weeks after the right-wing media darling moderated a
panel discussion with top Donald Trump health official Mehmet Oz during a
"Make America Healthy Again"
[summit](https://www.independent.co.uk/bulletin/news/russell-brand-dr-oz-
trump-maha-b3058751.html). There, Brand and Oz joked together about Brand
hugging another Trump official, Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins, with her
consent. "She initiated that contact, I shall make clear, doctor," Brand said.

On Thursday, the judge [rejected ](https://apnews.com/article/russell-brand-
rape-sexual-assault-trial-f840ec56b2c8dd88941460d81de81fc7)Brand's bail
request due to the possibility that he might flee, noting that Brand faces a
"significant" prison term. The prosecution argued Brand used his celebrity
status to exploit vulnerable women, acting as a "sexual predator" who was
driven by an "indiscriminate and voracious" appetite for sex.

The convictions relate to incidents at several different locations over the
course five years - at a radio station, a bar, a set, and Brand's home. The
allegations [first
emerged](https://www.theguardian.com/culture/2023/sep/17/a-timeline-of-sexual-
assault-allegations-against-russell-brand) in 2023, from bombshell reports by
several British news outlets, which prompted police to open an investigation.

By that time, Brand was already going through a political transformation.
Earlier in his career, Brand was a critic of capitalism, an advocate for
economic redistribution and social change, a sort-of spiritual anti-
establishment leftist in many respects.

During the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic, Brand transposed that anti-
establishment stance rightward, questioning the vaccines and peddling various
conspiracy theories, including one suggesting the pandemic was a deliberate
project to establish authoritarian global rule with permanent restrictions on
personal freedom. His transformation had him appearing frequently on more
right-leaning media, including with the right-wing, pro-Israel commentator Ben
Shapiro.

In early 2023, Brand
[posted](https://www.instagram.com/p/CpFnu_zOR6_/?img_index=2) a picture with
Don Trump Jr. and Kimberly Guilfoyle, who was the president's son's fiancee at
the time. (Guilfoyle went on to become Trump's ambassador to Greece, before
resigning in scandal.)

After the allegations against him emerged later that year, Brand's public
transformation accelerated. In 2024, Brand suddenly became religious and began
openly discussing Christianity's importance to him. In January, Brand
[posted](https://x.com/rustyrockets/status/1748988929020158003?a=PTTAXmN6FcY0LjJLypo&s=20)
a video explaining he wore a cross because "Christianity, and in particular,
the figure of Christ are, it seems to me, inevitably becoming more important
as I become more familiar with suffering, purpose, self, and not self."

By April, he was baptized in the River Thames. Brand
[said](https://www.businessinsider.com/russell-brand-announces-baptism-
opportunity-to-leave-past-behind-2024-4) the baptism was an "opportunity to
die and be reborn in Christ's name."

And he cozied up to MAGA. That July, Brand went to the 2024 Republican
National Convention, and [hosted](https://rumble.com/v57jstp-hes-grateful-to-
be-alive-eric-trump-on-his-fathers-assassination-attempt-li.html) interviews
with Trump's son Eric and the now-disgraced Ohio gubernatorial candidate Vivek
Ramaswamy. Brand also
[appeared](https://x.com/bennyjohnson/status/1813012391216415114?a=o0Hc_CBx569mGtzoBOM&s=20)
on the right-wing social media poster Benny Johnson's show.

In early 2025, Brand was a special guest at Trump's Mar-a-Lago Club, for an
event called "Celebrate American Exceptionalism." Brand
[joined](https://www.facebook.com/reel/1677572270157003) Trump, Ted Nugent,
and Mike Tyson, among others.

It was a who's who of alleged and convicted abusers. Tyson was
[convicted](https://www.history.com/this-day-in-history/february-10/boxing-
legend-convicted-of-raping-beauty-queen) of rape in 1992. Nugent has faced
[allegations](https://www.mediamatters.org/national-rifle-
association/notorious-misogynist-and-accused-child-molester-ted-nugent-spoke-
nra) of sexual misconduct with underage girls and has made several profane
comments against women. President Trump, himself, was found [liable
](https://www.npr.org/2023/05/09/1175071486/jury-finds-trump-liable-for-
sexual-abuse-in-e-jean-carrolls-civil-case)in a civil court for sexually
abusing writer E. Jean Carroll.

In October 2025, Brand appeared at an event with the Trump-aligned advocacy
group Turning Point USA.

The following month, Brand appeared at the first official "MAHA" summit,
joining Oz, then-White House AI and crypto adviser David Sacks, UFC president
Dana White, among others.

In December 2025, he spoke at AmericaFest, Turning Point USA's annual
conference, after the organization's founder, Charlie Kirk, was assassinated.
Brand spoke about Jesus, repentance, and his transformation to a Christian.

In April 2026, Piers Morgan asked Brand what Bible passages were relevant to
him when he brought a copy into court. Brand spent
[around](https://x.com/I_amMukhtar/status/2047782854772326876?a=a9FMCESPz6CVFyGqfQM&s=20)
100 seconds leafing through his Bible and was unsuccessful in finding the
verse he claimed he had in mind.

In late September, Brand
[appeared](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/29/health/maha-summit-kennedy-
vance.html) alongside Oz at the September MAHA summit that featured several
other Trump officials, including Vice President JD Vance and Health and Human
Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Weeks later, Brand was found guilty
of rape.

Brand joins a long list of Trumpworld figures who have faced allegations of
sex crimes.

Trump faces a litany of allegations of [rape
](https://apnews.com/article/trump-rape-carroll-trial-
fe68259a4b98bb3947d42af9ec83d7db)and sexual assault, in addition to the civil
finding of sexual abuse, including a [new
allegation](https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/wwe-mcmahons-must-face-
sex-abuse-claims-by-former-ring-boys-2026-10-20/) made public in late October,
which accuses Trump of working in tandem with his former friend Jeffrey
Epstein, the infamous financier, and raping a 24-year-old pageant contestant
and financial services professional. Trump denies the allegations.

Former informal Trump adviser George Nader [pled
guilty](https://courthousenews.com/trump-campaign-adviser-pleads-guilty-to-
child-porn-sex-trafficking/) to charges of child sex trafficking and
possessing child pornography. Trump's "secretary of war," Pete Hegseth, has
been [accused](https://zeteo.com/p/secretary-of-war-crimes-pete-hegseth) of
sexually assaulting a woman; while he denies the claims, he
[paid](https://zeteo.com/p/secretary-of-war-crimes-pete-hegseth) a $50,000
settlement to the complainant. Former congressman Matt Gaetz - who Trump
nominated to be attorney general and possibly oversee management of the
Epstein Files - is [accused](https://www.theguardian.com/us-
news/2026/oct/15/matt-gaetz-florida-sex-traffing-lawsuit) of sex trafficking
and engaging in sexual activity with a 17-year-old girl. (He denies the
allegations.)

Top Trump donor and former head of the so-called "Department of Government
Efficiency" Elon Musk [allegedly](https://www.businessinsider.com/spacex-
paid-250000-to-a-flight-attendant-who-accused-elon-musk-of-sexual-
misconduct-2022-5) exposed himself to a SpaceX flight attendant and offered to
buy her a horse in exchange for sexual favors; Musk also once
[asked](https://zeteo.com/p/elon-musk-jeffrey-epstein-files-island) Jeffrey
Epstein to invite him to the "wildest party" on his island. Former Trump
attorney Rudy Giuliani has been
[accused](https://www.courthousenews.com/judge-advances-10-million-sexual-
harassment-case-against-rudy-giuliani/) of sexual harassment. Trump education
secretary Linda McMahon is
[accused](https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/wwe-mcmahons-must-face-sex-
abuse-claims-by-former-ring-boys-2026-10-20/) of knowing about and enabling
alleged sexual abuse of teenage World Wrestling Entertainment staff, during
her tenure as CEO of the wrestling organization.

For Brand's part, following the trial, police in the UK have
[confirmed](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c6vgx8q09gg4o) they are actively
investigating two additional rape complaints against him.
